changes: New Auto deco tab in the editor: pick a theme and it decorates your track with ground, hills and scenery
Auto deco is a nerfed version of a private autodecorator, with the same idea but a different execution
Auto deco asks for a test run first so it knows where you drive
New Scenery category under Grass with 39 rocks, trees, plants, buildings and roadside blocks
Scenery is solid, except tall grass which you drive through
Scenery can be recolored with the same colors as normal blocks
Decorate before you set times, ghosts from the bare track can break on the decorated one
Fine grid: the blue cells on the block you are placing are half size too, so they match where it snaps
Rally car doesn't scrape and shake in bobsleigh curves anymore
Desert car doesn't scrape and shake in bobsleigh curves anymore
Fine grid: the grid button now has a third step, and Better Editor blocks move half a small step on it
Desert car has a new trophy truck body
Wheel info shows Road on a stock road under a Better Editor block, instead of Penalty grass
Bobsleigh: cars go straight over the top of a wall instead of rolling along the edge
Gentle slopes, a 3 x 4 block and penalty grass blocks in every kit
Overlapping water and finish blocks don't look darker anymore
